Day, Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice E.S.Indiresh
 Oral Judgment
1.
Heard learned counsel appearing for the parties in both the appeals.

2. MFA No.203923/2023 is arising out of the judgment and award dated 07.07.2023 in MVC No.940/2021, on the file of the Principal Senior Civil Judge and MACT - V at Vijayapura, awarding compensation to the claimant, seeking enhancement of compensation.

3. MFA No.203646/2023 is arising out of the judgment and award dated 07.07.2023 in MVC No.939/2021, on the file of the Principal Senior Civil Judge and MACT - V at Vijayapura, NC:
2026:KHC-K:883 HC-KAR awarding compensation to the claimant, seeking enhancement of compensation.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the Insurance Company vehemently argued for dismissal of the appeals.

5. Having taken note of the submissions made by the learned counsel appearing for the parties in MFA No.203923/2023 and the finding recorded by the Tribunal in MVC No.940/2021, there is no dispute as to the injury sustained by the claimant on account of the road traffic accident occurred on 08.02.2021.
On careful consideration of the medical certificate produced at Ex.P10, it is not in dispute that the claimant sustained injury and was treated as in-patient at the hospital for 3 days.

In that view of the matter, taking into consideration the fact that the claimant has not examined the treating doctor, I am of the view that, the claimant is entitled for global compensation of Rs.1,00,000/- with interest at 6% per annum from the date of claim petition till realization.

sentences.text: Having taken note of the submissions made by the learned counsel appearing for the parties in MFA No.203646/2023 and the finding recorded by the Tribunal in NC: 2026:KHC-K:883 HC-KAR MVC No.939/2021, it is not in dispute that the accident occurred on 08.02.2021, wherein the claimant sustained grievous injury.
In order to prove the disability, the claimant has examined the treating doctor as P.W.3, wherein P.W.3 has deposed that the permanent disability is about 55 to 65% in respect of right lower limb.
It is also forthcoming from the evidence on record that amputation was done above knee to the claimant.
In that view of the matter, taking into account the Schedule I of the Workmen's Compensation Act, Part - II, the assessment has to be made by taking into account the disability at 60%.
Taking into account the Judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Jagdish Vs. Mohan and Others, (2018) 4 SCC 571. wherein, 40% of the income has to be added.

sentences.text:
7. Taking into consideration the amputation of the knee is concerned, by applying the proper multiplier of 17 and since the accident is of the year 2021, taking into account the monthly income of the claimant at Rs.14,250/- as per the guidelines of the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority,
the claimant is entitled for Rs.24,41,880/- (14250+40% x 12 x 17 NC: 2026:KHC-K:883 HC-KAR x 60%) towards loss of future income on account of permanent disability.
Taking into consideration the grievous injury sustained by the claimant and the evidence of P.W.3, the award of compensation towards other heads is re
- assessed as follows:

Heads Amount  (in Rupees)
 Pain and suffering 1,00,000.00  Loss of earnings during laid up 42,750.00  period (Rs.14,250 x 3)
 Loss of amenities 1,00,000.00  Loss of future of earnings 24,41,880.00  Medical expenses 2,40,452.00  Total 29,25,082.00 8.

In view of the above observations, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The MFA No.202923/2023 is allowed in part.

(ii) The claimant is held entitled for total compensation of Rs.1,00,000/- (as against Rs.25,000/- awarded by the Tribunal), with interest at 6% per annum from the date of claim petition till realization.
